description: This is a Java unit test file for the class InstanceIdentifierSupplier within the org.eclipse.ditto.services.utils.config package. It contains test methods to verify singleton behavior, immutability, and environment variable handling of the InstanceIdentifierSupplier class.

classes.name: InstanceIdentifierSupplierTest
classes.description: Unit test class for InstanceIdentifierSupplier, testing singleton pattern, immutability, and environment variable interactions.

methods.name: setUp
methods.description: Initializes environment variables before each test by clearing the environment variable associated with instance index.

methods.name: assertImmutability
methods.description: Verifies that the InstanceIdentifierSupplier class is immutable, assuming specific fields are modified as part of an unobservable caching strategy.

methods.name: getInstanceReturnsSingleton
methods.description: Checks that multiple calls to getInstance() return the same singleton instance.

methods.name: instanceIndexIsObtainedFromEnvironmentVariable
methods.description: Tests that the supplier obtains the instance index from the environment variable and returns the expected value.

methods.name: instanceIndexIsObtainedFromHostNameSupplier
methods.description: Verifies that the instance index is obtained from HostNameSupplier when environment variable isn't set.

methods.name: tryToGetInstancePerReflection
methods.description: Creates an InstanceIdentifierSupplier instance via reflection, handling exceptions.

methods.name: getInstancePerReflection
methods.description: Uses reflection to instantiate InstanceIdentifierSupplier, circumventing caching.
